ruleDefinitions.name: NTLM Brute Force
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects common NTLM brute force device names Note: Unmapped fields: WorkstationName

sequences.query: event_id = 8004 AND (WorkstationName = "Rdesktop" OR WorkstationName = "Remmina" OR WorkstationName = "Freerdp" OR WorkstationName = "Windows7" OR WorkstationName = "Windows8" OR WorkstationName = "Windows2012" OR WorkstationName = "Windows2016" OR WorkstationName = "Windows2019")
